scope: The connected Toitū Otago Settlers Museum in Dunedin, with the Edwardian Burnside galleries, rounded Art Deco rail depot, rear collections ranges and modern glazed Josephine Foyer.

primaryWrittenSources.facts: Describes the Deco depot rail wing with plastered concrete, rounded corners, long parapet, vertical entry features and sawtooth roof with clerestories.
Interview with the project architects gives glass and steel at the arrowhead foyer, 6 to 6.9 metre ceilings and four interlinked buildings.
The contractor documents the current red Colorsteel depot roof and eight-metre-high skylights.
Dates and locates the public Josephine and NZR foyers in the connected campus.
